title: Steel Age PBR
description: Reflective textures for the ¨Steel Age¨ mod, You'll need a pbr enabled shaderpack in order for the reflections to work.
body: 32x semi-realistic/realistic texture pack meant to be used with ¨Steel Age¨ a mod that adds vanilla plus steel armors and tools. this resourse pack is designed to be used with a pbr enabled shader pack in order to benefit from the pbr settings.
